notes.title: Patchnotes 11 Oct 2021
notes.content:
Renamed the game executable from working title "Ore_O_Robos" to "StalakMiner". Please note that this change may have lost all savegames you had made previously. 

To recover these, copy the "Saved" folder found in %APPDATA%/Local/Ore_O_Robos/ into %APPDATA%/Local/StalakMiner/ after having boot the updated game once, and it should transfer over.

We have also fixed some other minor bugs that have been reported by players, and are currently working on tweaking the gameplay and mechanics. 

If you find any bugs, please join our Discord server and post about your issue in the "bug-reports" channel. :)
